specific_cases.source: FracPaQ User Guide v2.8, page 9, Figure 6
specific_cases.content: Adobe Illustrator user-interface screenshot with an underlying rock photograph and visible annotations/cropping.
specific_cases.finding: The published Adobe conditions require an entire, unaltered screenshot apart from resizing, required attribution and no third-party content. Compliance and permission for the underlying photograph have not been established for this copy.
specific_cases.dependency: Only the documentary manual-image integrity test includes this entry; it is not used by application analysis or the current PyFracPaQ manuals.
specific_cases.decision: Recommend excluding this documentary copy from the public repository while retaining it locally, or obtaining evidence covering the applicable rights. No exclusion/removal performed.
